title: Chapter test: the Web Server project
summary: Ten questions on HTTP, the thread pool and graceful shutdown. You need 70% to pass; you can retry and your best score is kept.

options: A Result<TcpStream> for each connection attempt

questions.q: Which line starts a valid HTTP response?
A body is `héllo`. What is its Content-Length?
questions.explanation: é is two bytes in UTF-8.

questions.q: Why does a single-threaded server answer `/` slowly while `/sleep` is running?
options: It handles one connection at a time, so / waits for /sleep to finish
questions.explanation: The second connection waits in the accept queue.

questions.q: What bound does a thread pool add compared to a thread per connection?
options: A limit on the number of threads
questions.explanation: At most N jobs run at once.

questions.q: How do several workers share one mpsc::Receiver?
questions.explanation: Arc for shared ownership across threads, Mutex for exclusive access.

questions.q: Which worker loop holds the lock while the job runs?
questions.explanation: while let keeps temporaries until the end of the block.

questions.q: What makes a worker leave its loop during shutdown?
options: recv returns Err after every sender has been dropped
questions.explanation: The book closes the channel by dropping the sender.
